a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate this round. Storms are a big risk for both of us, so let's get the reserve to 8 fast and then take 4 each. I won't take early, and I'll tell you straight if anything changes.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
